title: A brief history of AI executives calling for regulation
summary: Computing pioneer Alan Turing famously warned in a 1951 lecture that artificial intelligence would “meet with great opposition,” because undying machines “would not take long to outstrip our feeble powers” and would eventually “take control.” Calls for intervention, too, aren’t new.
